title: Dereth Town Tour - Fort Tethana scratch

shots.standingOrder: Rise from the ground south-west of the fort over the south gate towers to reveal the courtyard and the mountain behind; keep 35 m from the towers.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING (drone.rising-reveal). Starts 3 m above the shelf 165 m SW of the fort centre looking at the twin 31 m south gate towers, rises to z 276 drifting 30 m toward the fort: the gate towers block the view, then the camera clears them and the whole walled fort appears (six corner/gate towers, two mossy outer towers, cottages and the brick hall) with the Direlands mountain rising to z 480 behind. Peak 6.4 m/s. shots.standingOrder: Truck slowly north 12 m outside the west curtain wall at 4 m height with the head fixed on the wall; keep 7 m from the towers.
shots.notes: FACADE PAN: FORTRESS WALLS (classic.truck). Fixed-head lateral move 46 m north at x 7149.8, 12.4 m off the west curtain wall and 7.2 m off the protruding south-west and north-west tower faces, 4 m above the ground: the curtain wall and the two 31 m Aluvian corner towers slide past (towers rise out of frame), ending beyond the north-west tower with the plain and the mountain flank revealed. 6 m/s peak, a 2 m scree rock stays 7 m away. shots.standingOrder: Hold still at eye level and let the focus pull from the candelabra flames to the portal; keep 4 m from the town sign.
shots.notes: FX: FLAME + PORTAL (classic.rack-focus, real DoF). Locked at eye level (2.3 m) in the inner courtyard: a candelabra's flames sit right of centre 10 m away and in focus, the swirling Town Network portal soft behind; focus racks over 2 s around mid-shot to the portal 25 m away and the candelabra melts into bokeh. focusRange 2.5, bokehScale 3. Late-afternoon warm light. shots.standingOrder: Fly straight back south from the south-east tower while zooming in so it holds its size; keep 30 m from all towers.
shots.notes: LANDMARK (drone.vertigo-drone). From 42 m south of the south-east corner tower at z 250 the drone flies back to 125 m over the falling shelf (ground drops from 209 to 172) while the fov narrows 55 to 20 deg: the tower keeps its size and the fort's east towers and the mountain flank behind swell; peak 10 m/s. shots.standingOrder: Pull straight back and up from the statue over the south gate until the whole fort is in frame; stay 8 m above every roof.
shots.notes: CLOSING (classic.pull-out-reveal). Starts close on the Nullified Statue of a Grievver on its plinth in the west courtyard (an Anniversary Effect emitter sits on it), pulls back south and up (elevation 20 to 42 deg, perceptual profile) to z 290 above the south gate: the cottage roofs, the inner wall, the courtyard, the portal and finally the whole fort with its eight towers. Passes 8 m above the cottage roof and 19 m from the gate towers; peak 11.4 m/s.
